title: Latent Reuse in Agent Skills: Multi-modal Clone Detection at Ecosystem Scale
abstract: arXiv:2603.22447v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: An agent skill is a reusable package for extending an LLM agent, typically a SKILL.md file that combines YAML metadata, natural-language instructions, and executable code. Public repositories now host over two million skills, yet existing tools analyze each artifact in isolation, and registries do not track reuse created through copying, renaming, or adaptation. Detecting these links is difficult because reuse may appear in one channel while the others change; conventional single-channel clone detectors can therefore miss such adaptations. We present SkillReuse, a multi-modal clone detector that combines global lexical matching with channel-specific representations for YAML, prose, and code, then uses logistic regression to produce clone scores and interpretable clone-type labels. We also introduce SkillReuse-Bench, an annotated benchmark of 300 skill pairs spanning exact copies, renamed copies, adaptations, and semantic equivalents.

translated_title: 代理技能中的潜在重用：生态系统规模下的多模态克隆检测
translated_abstract: arXiv:2603.22447v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：代理技能是扩展LLM代理的可重用包，通常是一个SKILL.md文件，结合了YAML元数据、自然语言指令和可执行代码。公共仓库现在托管了超过两百万个技能，然而现有工具仅孤立地分析每个工件，注册表不跟踪通过复制、重命名或改编产生的重用。检测这些链接很困难，因为重用可能出现在一个通道中而其他通道发生变化；传统的单通道克隆检测器因此可能遗漏这些改编。我们提出SkillReuse，一种多模态克隆检测器，结合全局词汇匹配和针对YAML、散文和代码的通道特定表示，然后使用逻辑回归生成克隆分数和可解释的克隆类型标签。我们还引入了SkillReuse-Bench，一个包含300个技能对的注释基准，涵盖精确副本、重命名副本、改编和语义等价。
tldr: 本文提出SkillReuse，一种多模态克隆检测器，能有效识别代理技能中跨YAML、文本和代码通道的潜在重用，并引入SkillReuse-Bench基准验证其性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SkillReuse, a multi-modal clone detector that effectively identifies latent reuse across YAML, prose, and code channels in agent skills, and presents SkillReuse-Bench, an annotated benchmark for evaluation.
